Run TwoDescent(E : RemoveTorsion:=true). Over number fields Magma returns 2-coverings for the quotient of the 2-Selmer group after factoring out torsion. Require exactly one nontrivial residual covering; otherwise retain diagnostic output as OPEN and do not infer rank.
Run TwoCoverDescent(C) on that residual quartic with default PrimeBound/PrimeCutoff, so no local-prime truncation is introduced.

If the fake 2-Selmer set is nonempty, the run only exposes the next covering data and rank remains OPEN. A timeout/runtime/resource wall is also OPEN.
